snippet.title: Village 51 | Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Support Village 51 on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/karmanstudios/1883505230?ref=8jryqp&token=ce7645ae

Village 51 is a co-op farming and survival game set in rural Utah during the 1950s.

Build your farm, raise animals, gather resources, explore strange locations, and uncover a mystery hiding beneath the surface.

By day, life is peaceful.

By night, something is watching.

Inspired by farming, exploration, survival, and base-building games, Village 51 combines cozy progression with suspense, danger, and an unfolding alien conspiracy.

Build and expand your farm
Play solo or cooperatively
Raise livestock and manage resources
Investigate UFO activity and strange events
Construct, craft, and survive


Follow Village 51 for development updates and future announcements.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/village51game/?hl=es
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/sEnKgpJ83E
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@village51game

#Village51 #IndieGame #FarmingSim #SurvivalGame #CoopGame #GameDev #IndieGaming
